lead: A sans-io driver's fixture can agree with its parser on a byte order the wire does not use, and every gate stays green.
body: `tds/stream.rs`'s `login_ack` and its fixture both wrote LOGINACK's `TDSVersion` little-endian, and a real SQL Server refused; no `.nvst` case can open a socket. Before claiming a handshake reaches a server, run a scratch `.nvs` under `.agent-tmp/` against `tests/db/compose.yaml`'s endpoint with `target/debug/nvs.exe run`.
